t: Meeting with Tep could have led to our imminent downfall. Fortunately, the greatest scientist, necromancer, genius and villain in the history of Sarnaut was too conceited. Klavdia helped us to create a mysterious potion based on... faith. Only faith can change the very essence of the physical laws in the universe! Insane Tep achieved the divine power but lost his mind. Will you be lucky enough not to share his sad destiny?

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Brawler the Fierce near Tep's Pyramid (Level 54). Once you are done with your task, speak with Klavdia Kalugina at the Rebel Refuge to complete it (Level 54).

Imagination is a huge power. You can use it either to create or destroy. Anyone capable of creation is god-like - after all, what is creation? The embodiment of your willpower! Sarn, the God, exhausted and enraged by his imprisonment, gave birth to the Leper... Klavdia helped you restrain and defeat this godly creation and bring back Nezeb and Skrakan. This means that only through creation you may reach the mightiness of gods.
You can start this stage by speaking with Yasker in Nezebgrad at level 55. It leads to Umoir. Speak with Mark Staritsin in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 60.

Ask yourself, what do we really know about the Great Mages? What is the secret of their eternal life and their ability to keep the allods from being swallowed up by the astral? As far as I know, the Conclave's secrets remain undiscovered even now, thousands of years later. Who knows, maybe you'll be able to unlock one of these secrets!

Can only mages be truly Great, or can anyone, as long as they can attain the heights of power? And what is the difference between Greatness and divine power? Is it more than the ability to resist the astral, but also to bend the astral to one's will, or is it something greater still?

For your feats in service to the League, Aidenus has rewarded you with a vial of dragon blood and shown you the way to attain incredible power. But will you be strong enough to follow this path to its end and achieve Greatness? And is there more to this prize than just the desire to recognize a hero?

t: The Sculptor is a detached part of the Architect's mind who has gained his own consciousness and tried to convert the people of Sarnaut into his religion, promising them peace, well-being, and eternal Order. The fanatics' faith was so strong that it created a new, twisted life form, which embodied their idea of "eternal deity". Fortunately, the heroes defeated the spawn of the sick mind, but who knows what else a true faith is capable of? Can anyone stand against that kind of power at all?

You can count with your fingers those, who survived through facing them! Hard times are coming. We choose our own destiny, we won't blindly follow the gods' will, this is why we must find an answer to the question, what is god?

t:
The conflict between Demons, Demonologists, Demon Hunters, and the Church, orchestrated by the God of Darkness, has nearly undone the fragile peace in Sarnaut.

Nihaz made it clear that he wishes to be the ruler of this world. And he is not above using one of the greatest heroes of Sarnaut to dictate his will. It was only the intervention of Skulnar the Fierce that helped prevent the catastrophe.

What does Nihaz want with this world? Is there any chance he can be stopped?
You can start this stage by speaking with Nefer Ur near the Observatory on Ammer at level 75. It leads to Sogot. Speak with Nefer Ur near the Observatory again to complete it at level 80.

You can start this stage by speaking with Skulnar the Fierce near the Observatory on Ammer at level 80. It leads to Wellebell Preserve, Frontier, and Gipat. Speak with Skulnar the Fierce in Al Rihat Ruins to complete it.

It turns out that Nihaz and Sarn are just two of the many gods who represent certain facets of the universe, each embodying a particular aspect of power. One way or another, they were all part of the cycle of Creation and Destruction, reforming the universe bit by bit.

But then Nihaz turned against the other gods, unleashing the Great War. Nihaz wants to have the powers of Creation and the ability to create life. And capturing Sarn is just one step of his grand plan.
You can start this stage by speaking with Klavdia in Nihaz's Citadel at the maximum level. Speak with Lovewise Catfish in Novograd to complete it.

quests: Not All Spores are Equally Good!

t: Sarnaut is not the only world in the ocean of Creation. Apart from Sarn and Nihaz, there thousands of other gods. If we understand what lies beyond Sarnaut, it might help us in the war with Nihaz and threats from other worlds. But where do we start?

Every world, every god is just a tiny piece of the Creation, but those are important pieces. The confrontation of the two gods, the imprisonment and death of Sarn, the birth and development of this world - all this was preordained.  This is how the Creation works. This is how it creates life.

Some gods have come to learn it; some, despite of their tremendous power, could never get close to the mystery of life. It seems that Nihaz is really interested in the Aoidoi as a side effect of Sarn's and Architect's death.

You can start this stage by speaking with Klavdia in Nihaz's Citadel at the maximum level. Speak with Mark Staritsin in Yasker's Tower to complete it.
Is there evil in our world that the God of Darkness hasn't had a hand in? But what is he trying to achieve?
Nihaz's plans are cunning and convoluted. What does the God of Darkness want? Exact revenge on those who turned on him? Or is it something else?

So the prophesy is coming true - Nihaz is willing to destroy this world along with all its inhabitants. But his motives are still unclear - is it vengeance? Or is Nihaz trying to prevent something else? What's hidden behind his Seals?

In any event, we have no choice but to challenge him again!
Cosmos starts this stage of the World Mystery in the Observatory on the Dionic Archipelago (Level 85), and Catherina finishes it there (Level 85).

Terrible news: after Kyros and the Wanderer went through the Well of Souls, Nihaz found a way to influence the power of the two deities. For some reason, all the Aoidos born after the event obey the God of Darkness.

Does this mean Cosmos is acting in his interests? It's hard to believe, because you can't find a more staunch opponent of Nihaz than the Dominus of Creation!
Stephane de Doucer starts this stage of the World Mystery in Foul Dale (Level 88), and Zayan finishes it there (Level 88).
Dakkar de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery in Gipat (Level 89) and finishes it there (Level 89).

Klavdia intends to fight Nihaz. For that, she needs to create the Gates to another world where her "mother" rules. This world is apparently under attack by Nihaz. However, that doesn't mean Sarnaut is safe - the Dark God could have been behind the attempt to disrupt the construction of the new Gates on Suslanger. We must find out more!
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Dakkar de Desirae in Gipat (Level 90). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 90).

Mysterious Alice claims that she's Klavdia from the future! She wanted to warn us about the Gate-III first opening and its consequences. According to Alice, we must stop. Trying to find her "mother" is dangerous. Will Klavdia from our time agree? Is this all part of Nihaz's plan?
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Alice on Suslanger (Level 96). Once you are done with your task, speak with Alice to complete it (Level 96).

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with the Great Mage Simon on Suslanger (Level 96). Once you are done with your task, speak with Semer Akhenaten on Eden to complete it (Level 96).
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Skulnar the Fierce on Eden (Level 97). Once you are done with your task, speak with the All-Mother on Eden to complete it (Level 97).

All-Mother's lessons taught you that death according to her is only part of the natural cycle of everything that has ever existed. Her children share her views and live in harmony with the nature. However, some rejected her teachings. You ran into Hirkalla, Klavdia's sister, who attracted corrupted Children on her side.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with the All-Mother on Eden (Level 98). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 98).

All-Mother's lessons allow you to see deeper into the conflict with Nihaz. The All-Mother considers all elements important, be it Light or Darkness. As the god of Darkness, Nihaz was assigned his own tasks in accordance with her will. It seems that his main fault was resisting her will and acting of his own accord. You also met Hirkalla. She seemed very interested in you after hearing about you from a mysterious Madman from Sarnaut. The goddess of Darkness started a rebellion on Eden, drawing some of the Children to her side.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with the All-Mother on Eden (Level 99). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 100) .
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with the All-Mother on Eden (Level 99). Once you are done with your task, speak with Catherina's on Eden to complete it (Level 100).

t: How's the Great Ball going on? Did they manage to avoid accidents this time?

The Great Ball is a marvelous event in the lives of all elves. It takes place once in several decades. The previous Ball was disrupted by Armando de Doucer, who corrupted the Galleon Castle on Tenebra. Stakes are growing higher! Victory of one of the Houses may influence the confrontation of the Empire and the League.

What? I can't believe this!

Who could've thought we'd run into the House de Velund? There are only vague legends about Elleken. And Louis's decision to contact him seems rather reckless...

Even though Zayan took on training Skulnar the Fierce, I don't think it's the end of it. Orcs got their Great Mage after all, which means.... Shamans have a strong argument in their favor now.

We've received news from Siveria - the word of Skulnar has reached them, too. Orcs started leaving their settlements. Where are they going? I don't know.

But intelligence reports that the Empire is moving its troops to Izune - the orcs' main allod. Perhaps the rebellion Yasker feared has already started. A few years ago I would've been happy to hear about trouble in the Empire, but now... when they are our allies... I don't know what to think!

The world is changing. Irreversibly. Orcs, elves, and even Gibberlings... they seem to be willing to go their own way.
You have solved the "Great Ball" mystery

This time the elven King Louis invited representatives of all races of Sarnaut to the Great Ball. The Sarnaut hero received the invitation as well. Aidenus wants to use this opportunity to persuade elves to quit the Empire.
Zayan starts this step of the World Mystery on Al Rihat (Level 90), and Louis de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

Both the League and the Empire are pursuing their goals during the Great Ball. The event is full of mysteries, intrigues, and secrets. The confrontation between the Great Houses is heating up. As always, those, whose job is to take orders, suffer the most. Among them is a servant of Queen Lucretia, the harpy Constance, who got caught in a trap thanks to a mysterious assistant of the Cardinal, Renard de Ardeur.
Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Lucretia de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

All this scheming on Irene leads to unexpected discoveries. It turns out that Queen Lucretia is secretly corresponding with Xadaganians, and King Louis has enlisted the help of Skulnar the Fierce. Strange actors from the wandering theater, who recently arrived at Irene, take keen interest in the orc psionicist. Apart from that, we managed to find out the cardinal's assistant is Eurial, whom we've already met. She doesn't have any idea of what lies ahead.
Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Lucretia de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

The Great Ball is on! Every Great House is looking to win the competitions and seeking all possible means to achieve it. King Louis is dreaming about peace for his subjects. He asks to find one of Antoinette's elven daughters. She was captured by the Empire, and had to leave the Royal Court. The elven lady, Iris de Delice, seemingly has some information that might shed some light on the mysteries of Irene.
Louis de Desirae starts and finishes this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90).

You managed to find out more about the events on Irene. It seems that the disappearance of Iris de Delice is connected with Eurial's affairs. Eurial is spying on Queen Lucretia de Desirae. She knows of her connection with a high-ranking officer of the Empire and wants to use the information against her and her allies.
Louis de Desirae starts and finishes this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90).
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Louis de Desirae on Irene at level 90. It leads to Ferris. Speak with Lucretia de Desirae to complete it.

The Great Ball is in full swing! Rivers of wine are flowing, beautiful ladies are showing off their outfits, and men are making speeches. Each of the Great Houses strives to win and demonstrate their achievements. But it is not yet clear who will win.
Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Baudouin de Grandeur finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

House de Delice won a convincing victory at the Great Ball! Which means the League failed to achieve its goals. We can only hope Antoinette de Delice won't end the alliance with Kania. In addition to that, the Great Houses also decided to grant an amnesty to the vampires and the House de Doucer. This Great Ball passed seemingly without incident - does this mean everything is over and the forces that intervened in the Great Game remain unrevealed?
Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene and finishes it there (Level 90).

The intrigue that had been carefully built up at the Great Ball reached its resolution - Skulnar the Fierce was kidnapped by Eurial and her accomplices, unknown elves! He was taken to ancient catacombs, and his further fate is shrouded in mystery! You have no choice but to follow them, hoping to save Skulnar. But first you need to get through the collapsed passage.
Skulnar the Fierce starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Constance finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

quests: That is when the fun begins...

t:
The truth is out! You have unraveled the tangle of intrigues surrounding the Great Ball!

The first of the Great Mages, Elleken learned about the Star Gates from Nihaz. He decided to leave Sarnaut and started looking for a perfect navigator who possessed unparalleled intuition to help him travel between worlds. For that purpose, he stole the Key of Creation, a powerful artifact, one of Nihaz's Seals. Using this Key, he changed an orc, granting him magical abilities. He was working on it with the House de Vevre on the Grok allod. But then his plans failed. Lorzub the Fierce, who later became known as the Legendary Orc, died in the attempt to become a Great Mage.

But Elleken did not know he had an offspring. Only after learning of Skulnar the Fierce, the first of the Great Mages decided to make another attempt at initiating the orc as a Great Mage. He contacted Caspar de Vevre and King Louis de Desirae to arrange for Skulnar to be invited to the Ball. After that, he only needed to get him to the Draconid held captive deep in the allod.

Now Skulnar the Fierce has no choice but to complete the Great Mage training - or he will die! Who knows what the appearance of a Great Orc Mage would mean for Sarnaut?
Constance starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Skulnar the Fierce finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

What? I can't believe this!

Who could've thought we'd run into the House de Velund? There are only vague legends about Elleken. And Louis's decision to contact him seems rather reckless...

Even though Zayan took on training Skulnar the Fierce, I don't think it's the end of it. Orcs got their Great Mage after all, which means.... Shamans have a strong argument in their favor now.

Alas, we've started receiving terrible news - there's a riot on Izune. Of course, it's the Shamans who stirred it up as soon as they heard about Skulnar. Yasker already ordered the army to move in. There's trouble in other places as well. Orcs are worried, prophets keep popping up who predict that, "the new Great Feast is around the corner"...

Nezeb was right when he said more orcs meant more problems! Without wars, they wilt, start making trouble, turn to crime, and there have been no wars since Dane... Now we have our hands full.

The world is changing. Irreversibly. Orcs, elves, and even Gibberlings... they seem to be willing to go their own way.
You have solved the "Great Ball" mystery

This time the elven King Louis invited representatives of all races of Sarnaut to the Great Ball. The Sarnaut hero received the invitation as well. Yasker wants to use this opportunity to persuade elves to quit the League.
Zayan starts this step of the World Mystery on Al Rihat (Level 90), and Louis de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).
Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Lucretia de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

All this scheming on Irene leads to unexpected discoveries. It turns out that Queen Lucretia is secretly corresponding with Xadaganians, and King Louis has enlisted the help of Skulnar the Fierce. Strange actors from the wandering theater, who recently arrived at Irene, take keen interest in the orc psionicist. Apart from that, we managed to find out the cardinal's assistant is Eurial, whom we've already met. She doesn't have any idea of what lies ahead.
Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Lucretia de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).
Louis de Desirae starts and finishes this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90).

You managed to find out more about the events on Irene. It seems that the disappearance of Iris de Delice is connected with Eurial's affairs. Eurial is spying on Queen Lucretia de Desirae. She knows of her connection with a high-ranking officer of the Empire and wants to use the information against her and her allies.
Louis de Desirae starts and finishes this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90).
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Louis de Desirae on Irene at level 90. It leads to Ferris. Speak with Lucretia de Desirae to complete it.

The Great Ball is in full swing! Rivers of wine are flowing, beautiful ladies are showing off their outfits, and men are making speeches. Each of the Great Houses strives to win and demonstrate their achievements. But it is not yet clear who will win.
Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Baudouin de Grandeur finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

House de Delice won a convincing victory at the Great Ball! Which means the Empire has achieved its goals. In addition to that, the Great Houses also decided to grant an amnesty to the vampires and the House de Doucer. This Great Ball passed seemingly without incident - does this mean everything is over and the forces that intervened in the Great Game remain unrevealed?
Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene and finishes it there (Level 90).

The intrigue that had been carefully built up at the Great Ball reached its resolution - Skulnar the Fierce was kidnapped by Eurial and her accomplices, unknown elves! He was taken to ancient catacombs, and his further fate is shrouded in mystery! You have no choice but to follow them, hoping to save Skulnar. But first you need to get through the collapsed passage.
Skulnar the Fierce starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Constance finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

quests: That is when the fun begins...

t:
The truth is out! You have unraveled the tangle of intrigues surrounding the Great Ball!

The first of the Great Mages, Elleken learned about the Star Gates from Nihaz. He decided to leave Sarnaut and started looking for a perfect navigator who possessed unparalleled intuition to help him travel between worlds. For that purpose, he stole the Key of Creation, a powerful artifact, one of Nihaz's Seals. Using this Key, he changed an orc, granting him magical abilities. He was working on it with the House de Vevre on the Grok allod. But then his plans failed. Lorzub the Fierce, who later became known as the Legendary Orc, died in the attempt to become a Great Mage.

But Elleken did not know he had an offspring. Only after learning of Skulnar the Fierce, the first of the Great Mages decided to make another attempt at initiating the orc as a Great Mage. He contacted Caspar de Vevre and King Louis de Desirae to arrange for Skulnar to be invited to the Ball. After that, he only needed to get him to the Draconid held captive deep in the allod.

Now Skulnar the Fierce has no choice but to complete the Great Mage training - or he will die! Who knows what the appearance of a Great Orc Mage would mean for Sarnaut?
Constance starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Skulnar the Fierce finishes it on Irene (Level 90).
What awaits the League and Empire?

The League and the Empire have been around for more than two hundred years. These are alliances of peoples brought together by common interests. But will they survive the coming upheaval? Will the Gibberlings and Elves remain in the League? While the Orcs and rebellious Zem stay in the Empire? Or will the upcoming conflicts lead to the creation of new alliances?

Skulnar the Fierce became the Great Mage, and it led to the revolt of the Orcs. Now the shamans of our people, and the warriors who joined them, have sworn allegiance to the new leader, the Legendary Orc. They believe Skulnar is the one.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Fury the Merciless on Suslanger (Level 94). Once you are done with your task, speak with Eladia on Suslanger to complete it (Level 94).

quests: And the Legendary Orc was reborn!

t: Perhaps the conflict of League and Empire is history? New generations are learning to live in peace, cooperate, resolve arguments with words. At least this is the case in the Dune pioneer camp where all races of Sarnaut meet. Will this friendship become an eternal alliance?
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Eladia on Suslanger (Level 95). Once you are done with your task, speak with Alice on Suslanger to complete it (Level 95).

Gray Prince wants to bring Nezeb back to life. Is it possible? Skulnar managed to cheat death, but can the Great Mage of Xadagan repeat this? Will the return of the first Emperor lead to a conflict with Yasker? And what is Nezeb going to do in a new world?
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Gray Prince on Suslanger (Level 96). Once you are done with your task, speak with Eladia on Suslanger to complete it (Level 96).

The journey to Eden caused a new rift. Choosing between the Expedition from Sarnaut or the Children, the natives of Eden, will have a decisive impact on the future of many worlds. Each side has its own truth, and now everyone in Eden needs to decide which side they are on. This threatens to break the precious truce achieved at a high cost. Perhaps you are witnessing the beginnings of a conflict that will last for centuries, just like the war between Kania and Xadagan back in the day.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Catherina in Eden at level 100. Once you are done with your task, speak with her again to complete it.

The discovery of Isa, the original homeland of the Gibberlings, raises new questions about the future of this people. Will they stay in the League they once joined in search of their old home, or will they choose neutrality? The appearance of the first Skulnar, the legendary leader of the Horde, also raises many questions.
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Froddy the Fidget on Isa at level 105. Once you are done with your task, speak with Aidenus in Novograd.

You've managed to accomplish the impossible - bring Nezeb and Skrakan back to life! The fate of the entire Sarnaut will change forever. Where will this all lead? How will the Empire react to the return of its Emperor? How will the League's policies change with the return of the oldest of the Great Human Mages? Who knows...
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Hirkalla on Jigran at level 110. Once you are done with your task, speak with her again to complete it.

What fate awaits all of us?

Using your Weaver powers, you managed to enter the Hall of Fates where you stopped the spirit of an ancient Orc chieftain from binding the fate of the Gibberlings to his own. You also encountered the Fate of the All-Mother and managed to change it. What you learned on Isa raises the following questions: is Fate some kind of force that surpasses even demiurges? And what can oppose Fate?
You can start this stage by speaking with Styr Ruff on Isa at level 104. Once you are done with your task, speak with Unn on Isa.

You have seen something extraordinary - a mysterious creature calling itself "the Scissors". If Unn was not mistaken, then they are your eternal enemy, because you are the Weaver who binds the Threads. But what do the Scissors want? Did your intervention in the fate of the Gibberlings summon them?
You can start this stage by speaking with Yasker in Yasker's Tower at level 105. Once you are done, speak with Negus Tot in Yasker's Tower.

Looks like the Scissors have made their move. According to Alice, the fates of some ancient inhabitants of Sarnaut tragically changed: instead of becoming key figures in history, they are "odd people out" - people without destinies. What kind of force can steal someone's destiny?
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Alice in Dar Ulgorn at level 107. Once you are done with your task, speak with her again to complete it.

A Zem scientist has learned the following: the Spark is a multi-component entity contained in the concept of "soul". The Spark contains a certain "primordial flame" which makes it the basis of life. The flame is surrounded by the Threads of Fate. Invisible and ethereal, they extend from each Spark out into space. The Scissors cut the Threads of certain people, changing their place in the Pattern.
You can start this stage by speaking with Iaver Bazar in Dar Ulgorn on Jigran at level 109. Once you are done with your task, speak with him again to complete it.
You can start this stage by speaking with Alyosha in Dar Ulgorn on Jigran at level 109. Once you are done with your task, speak with him again to complete it.
